records.text: A newspaper birth announcement says Erika Kirk was born on November 20, 1988, at Good Samaritan Hospital in Cincinnati.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Erika Frantzve (Erika Kirk), we are told, ... was born on November 20th, 1988 in Cincinnati, ... Ohio. ... There's a newspaper relic announcing her birth two weeks later on December 6th that tells us that she was born at Good Samaritan Hospital.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct citation to a newspaper clipping). Current searches confirm the publicly reported November 20, 1988 birth date and Ohio birth, but found no accessible scan, newspaper archive entry, or independent source confirming the claimed December 6 birth announcement or Good Samaritan Hospital. Unable to verify the actual cited document.

records.text: Sources disagree whether Erika Kirk was born on November 20 or November 22, 1988, at Good Samaritan Hospital
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So we learned that Erika (Erika Kirk) was born at the Good Samaritan Hospital on either the 20th or the 22nd of November of 1988. It depends on who's telling the stories. Erika (Erika Kirk), is it Lori (Lori Frantzve)?

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Current public biographical sources consistently report November 20, 1988 and identify Good Samaritan Hospital in Cincinnati; no reliable current source located supports a November 22 alternative.

sources.title: Erika Kirk birthdate and place of birth
sources.relevance: Current-source review reports consistent November 20 dating and Good Samaritan Hospital.

records.text: Good Samaritan Hospital was gifted by the Marine Corps after the Corps was caught experimenting on human brains
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Is it Erika (Erika Kirk)'s dad? A hospital graciously gifted by the Marine Corps after they were kind of caught experimenting on human brains.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Good Samaritan's own history confirms a notorious 1874 human-brain experiment at the hospital, but says the institution began as St. John's in 1852 and was renamed in 1866; it does not support the claimed Marine Corps gift or causal sequence.

sources.title: Good Samaritan Hospital: Our History
sources.relevance: Hospital history documents the 1852/1866 institutional timeline and the 1874 brain experiment.
